name: @alchm/mcp-server

tools.name: get_live_sky_transits
tools.description: Calculate live astronomical transits, planetary degree alignments, and active elements for any coordinates under the vault. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of target location (default NYC: 40.7498)

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of target location (default NYC: -73.7976)

tools.name: alchemize_ingredients
tools.description: Ingests an array of raw food items, looks up their elemental values, and translates them into Spirit (Fire), Essence (Water), Matter (Earth), and Substance (Air) ratios, calculating overall thermodynamic metrics and alchemical harmony. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients in the pantry/fridge (e.g. ['tomato', 'basil', 'garlic'])

tools.name: generate_cosmic_recipe
tools.description: Queries the complete 579 alchemical recipe database to discover cosmic, cosmos-aligned dishes matching specific keyword prompts, cuisines, elements, and dietary restrictions. Costs 7.5 of each ESMS token when called with an authenticated _meta.apiKey. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

dominantElement.description: Target dominant cosmic element of the recipe

tools.name: compute_synastry_overlay
tools.description: Compute the inter-aspect ledger between two agents' natal charts: pairwise planet-to-planet aspects (conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition) with orb/exactness, plus tension / harmony / intensification scores and a recommended target stance (clash | absorb | mirror). Drives the desktop Jing Arena's counter-move pool selection. Pure math; pg cache used when seeded. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

natalChart.description: Natal chart with planets keyed by name, each having {sign, degree, retrograde?, house?}

focusPlanets.description: Planets to include (default: Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter)

cacheStrategy.description: read = use synastry_scores if present; write = compute and upsert; bypass = compute, skip pg. Default: read.

tools.name: get_transit_natal_overlay
tools.description: Compute the current sky × one agent's natal chart: which transiting planets are activating which natal points, with aspect type/orb/exactness, dominant boost element, and continuous boost magnitude (0..1). Replaces the global 'Transit Active' badge with per-agent overlays. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

transitTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the transit moment (default: now)

latitude.description: Latitude for the transit chart (default: 40.7498 NYC)

longitude.description: Longitude for the transit chart (default: -73.7976 NYC)

focusPlanets.description: Transiting planets to include (default: Sun, Moon, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Pluto)
